title: Independent current-SHA reclosure of places_1 changes

scope.entities: Six repaired place profiles plus Ijon in 1KI/2KI and Dothan in 2KI.

reviewMethod: Read each current draft and evidence sidecar, verified current draft/evidence bindings and profile serialization SHA, checked the exact pinned WEB verse and nearby text, and reread active Wikipedia article/section targets. Null-profile candidates were assessed against the WEB occurrence rather than treated as Wikipedia no-fit.

overallFindingJa: 9件のcurrent SHAを照合。明示された本文地名に合う2件はpass、7件は場所の正確な同定やプロフィール対象の成立に限定的な不確実性が残るためqualified。失敗はない。Kue/Tishbeのnullは原典上の同定不足（Kueは該節に名前自体がない、TishbeはTishbite語義未確定）であり、記事不在の断定ではない。
